1	import "server-only"
2	
3	import { createHash, randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto"
4	import bcrypt from "bcryptjs"
5	import { eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm"
6	import { db, type AdminDatabaseTransaction } from "@/lib/db"
7	import { adminSecurityAudit, adminUsers } from "@/lib/schema"
8	import { AdminIdentityError } from "@/lib/admin-users"
9	import { hasCapability } from "@/lib/rbac"
10	import { marketGate } from "@/lib/expansion-gates"
11	import { acceptOnActivation, agreementForInvitation, assertIssuableAgreement } from "./partner-agreements-core"
12	import { notifyPartner, partnerPortalOrigin } from "./partner-notifications"
13	
14	export function requirePartnerActivationEnabled() {
15	  if (process.env.PARTNER_ACTIVATION_ENABLED !== "true") {
16	    throw new AdminIdentityError("Partner activation is currently closed.", 403, "partner_activation_closed")
17	  }
18	}
19	
20	export function invitationHash(token: string) {
21	  return createHash("sha256").update(token).digest("hex")
22	}
23	
24	export function validateActivationCredential(token: unknown, password: unknown) {
25	  if (typeof token !== "string" || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/.test(token)) throw new AdminIdentityError("Invitation is invalid or unavailable.", 400, "invitation_invalid")
26	  if (typeof password !== "string" || password.length < 12 || Buffer.byteLength(password, "utf8") > 72) throw new AdminIdentityError("Use a password of at least 12 characters and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes.", 400, "password_invalid")
27	  return { token, password }
28	}
29	
30	/** Caller owns the transaction; applicant lock prevents two founders issuing twice. */
31	/** Fails closed: an unknown or unapproved operating market can never be invited or activated. Shared with market administration via advisory lock 7102. */
32	async function assertOperatingMarketApproved(tx: AdminDatabaseTransaction, country: string, code: string, message: string) {
33	  await tx.execute(sql`select pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared(7102)`)
34	  const market = (await tx.execute(sql`select status,plan_keys from expansion_markets where country_code=${country} for share`)).rows[0] as { status: string; plan_keys: string[] } | undefined
35	  if (marketGate(country, market, "*") !== "approved") throw new AdminIdentityError(message, 409, code)
36	}
37	/** Issues one published agreement version with the invitation; the partner must accept exactly that version to activate. */
38	export async function issueInvitation(tx: AdminDatabaseTransaction, applicationId: number, founderId: string, agreementVersionId: unknown, operatingCountry = "GB") {
39	  requirePartnerActivationEnabled()
40	  const [founder] = await tx.select().from(adminUsers).where(eq(adminUsers.id, founderId)).for("share").limit(1)
41	  if (!founder?.active || !hasCapability(founder.role, "expansion.manage")) throw new AdminIdentityError("Founder authority is required.", 403, "forbidden")
42	  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(applicationId) || applicationId < 1) throw new AdminIdentityError("Application is required.")
43	  const { versionId, label: agreementVersion } = await assertIssuableAgreement(tx, agreementVersionId)
44	  const result = await tx.execute(sql`select id, name, email, status, onboarding_confirmations as confirmations from partner_applications where id = ${applicationId} for update`)
45	  const applicant = result.rows[0] as { id: number; name: string; email: string; status: string; confirmations: Record<string, unknown> } | undefined
46	  const prerequisites = applicant?.confirmations
47	  if (!applicant || applicant.status !== "onboarding" || !prerequisites || !["agreement", "legal", "independentStatus", "operations"].every((key) => prerequisites[key] === true)) throw new AdminIdentityError("Record every onboarding confirmation before inviting a partner.", 409, "onboarding_incomplete")
48	  if (!/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(operatingCountry)) throw new AdminIdentityError("Use a two-letter ISO country code for the operating market.")
49	  // International applicants can be reviewed and progressed to onboarding, but are not invited until a founder has approved their operating market.
50	  await assertOperatingMarketApproved(tx, operatingCountry, "operating_market_not_approved", "This partner's operating market is not approved, so an invitation cannot be issued. The application can still be reviewed.")
51	  const now = new Date()
52	  const expiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
53	  const token = randomBytes(32).toString("base64url")
54	  const existing = await tx.execute(sql`select p.id,p.user_id,p.invitation_hash,p.activated_at,u.active,u.role,p.invitation_expires_at <= now() as invitation_expired from expansion_partners p join admin_users u on u.id=p.user_id where p.application_id = ${applicationId} for update of p,u`)
55	  const pending = existing.rows[0]
56	  if (pending) {
57	    // Revocation clears the hash. An expired invitation can be renewed, but a
58	    // revoked or activated identity cannot be silently revived by this command.
59	    if (pending.active !== false || pending.role !== "independent_partner" || pending.activated_at !== null || !pending.invitation_hash || pending.invitation_expired !== true) throw new AdminIdentityError("An invitation already exists or this partner requires explicit founder review.", 409, "invitation_exists")
60	    const partnerId = String(pending.id)
61	    await tx.execute(sql`update expansion_partners set invitation_hash=${invitationHash(token)}, invitation_expires_at=${expiresAt}, agreement_version=${agreementVersion}, agreement_content_version_id=${versionId}, confirmed_at=${now}, operating_country=${operatingCountry} where id=${partnerId}`)
62	    await tx.insert(adminSecurityAudit).values({ actorUserId: founder.id, targetUserId: String(pending.user_id), action: "partner_invitation_reissued", success: true, metadataJson: { partnerId, applicationId, agreementVersion, agreementVersionId: versionId, expiresAt: expiresAt.toISOString() } })
63	    return { partnerId, invitationToken: token, expiresAt: expiresAt.toISOString() }
64	  }
65	  const email = applicant.email.trim().toLowerCase()
66	  const collision = await tx.execute(sql`select id from admin_users where lower(email) = ${email}`)
67	  if (collision.rows.length) throw new AdminIdentityError("An identity already exists for this email; founder review is required.", 409, "identity_exists")
68	  const partnerId = randomUUID()
69	  const [identity] = await tx.insert(adminUsers).values({ email, displayName: applicant.name, role: "independent_partner", active: false, passwordHash: await bcrypt.hash(randomBytes(48).toString("base64url"), 12) }).returning({ id: adminUsers.id })
70	  await tx.execute(sql`insert into expansion_partners (id, user_id, application_id, agreement_version, agreement_content_version_id, confirmed_at, invitation_hash, invitation_expires_at, operating_country, created_at) values (${partnerId}, ${identity.id}, ${applicationId}, ${agreementVersion}, ${versionId}, ${now}, ${invitationHash(token)}, ${expiresAt}, ${operatingCountry}, ${now})`)
71	  await tx.insert(adminSecurityAudit).values({ actorUserId: founder.id, targetUserId: identity.id, action: "partner_invitation_issued", success: true, metadataJson: { partnerId, applicationId, agreementVersion, agreementVersionId: versionId, expiresAt: expiresAt.toISOString() } })
72	  return { partnerId, invitationToken: token, expiresAt: expiresAt.toISOString() }
73	}
74	
75	/** The agreement an invitation holder must read and accept. Read-only: the invitation is not consumed. */
76	export async function previewInvitationAgreement(tokenInput: unknown) {
77	  requirePartnerActivationEnabled()
78	  if (typeof tokenInput !== "string" || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/.test(tokenInput)) throw new AdminIdentityError("Invitation is invalid or unavailable.", 400, "invitation_invalid")
79	  return db.transaction((tx) => agreementForInvitation(tx, invitationHash(tokenInput)))
80	}
81	
82	/** Token is consumed, the issued agreement accepted and the password committed atomically; never creates a session. */
83	export async function activatePartnerInvitation(tokenInput: unknown, passwordInput: unknown, acceptanceInput?: unknown): Promise<void> {
84	  requirePartnerActivationEnabled()
85	  const credential = validateActivationCredential(tokenInput, passwordInput)
86	  // Hash before locking to bound lock duration. Rate limiting precedes this service.
87	  const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(credential.password, 12)
88	  const activated = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
89	    const result = await tx.execute(sql`select p.id, p.user_id, p.application_id, p.operating_country from expansion_partners p join admin_users u on u.id = p.user_id join partner_applications a on a.id = p.application_id where p.invitation_hash = ${invitationHash(credential.token)} and p.invitation_expires_at > now() and p.activated_at is null and u.active = false and u.role = 'independent_partner' and a.status = 'onboarding' and a.onboarding_confirmations @> '{"agreement":true,"legal":true,"independentStatus":true,"operations":true}'::jsonb for update of p, u, a`)
90	    const invitation = result.rows[0] as { id: string; user_id: string; application_id: number; operating_country: string } | undefined
91	    if (!invitation) throw new AdminIdentityError("Invitation is invalid or unavailable.", 400, "invitation_invalid")
92	    // Re-checked at the moment of activation: a market suspended after the invitation was issued stops the activation, and nothing is consumed.
93	    await assertOperatingMarketApproved(tx, invitation.operating_country, "operating_market_not_approved", "Activation is not available for this market yet. Contact ScaleSmiths.")
94	    // The partner accepts the exact issued version while still inactive; the database refuses activation without it.
95	    const { acceptanceId, agreement } = await acceptOnActivation(tx, invitation.id, invitation.user_id, acceptanceInput)
96	    const now = new Date()
97	    await tx.update(adminUsers).set({ passwordHash, active: true, passwordChangedAt: now, sessionVersion: sql`${adminUsers.sessionVersion} + 1`, updatedAt: now }).where(eq(adminUsers.id, invitation.user_id))
98	    await tx.execute(sql`update expansion_partners set invitation_hash = null, invitation_expires_at = null, activated_at = ${now} where id = ${invitation.id}`)
99	    await tx.execute(sql`update partner_applications set status = 'activated' where id = ${invitation.application_id}`)
100	    await tx.insert(adminSecurityAudit).values({ actorUserId: invitation.user_id, targetUserId: invitation.user_id, action: "partner_activated", success: true, metadataJson: { partnerId: invitation.id, applicationId: invitation.application_id, acceptanceId, agreementVersionId: agreement.versionId, agreementVersion: agreement.version, sha256: agreement.sha256 } })
101	    const [identity] = await tx.select({ email: adminUsers.email, name: adminUsers.displayName }).from(adminUsers).where(eq(adminUsers.id, invitation.user_id)).limit(1)
102	    return { partnerId: invitation.id, applicationId: invitation.application_id, email: identity.email, name: identity.name }
103	  })
104	  // Welcome email after the activation has committed; its outcome never affects the activation.
105	  try {
106	    await db.transaction((tx) => notifyPartner(tx, { to: activated.email, partnerId: activated.partnerId, applicationId: activated.applicationId, idempotencyKey: `activated-${activated.partnerId}`,
107	      email: { kind: "activated", name: activated.name, signInUrl: `${partnerPortalOrigin()}/login` } }))
108	  } catch { /* recorded as a warning by the notifier; activation already succeeded */ }
109	}
110

docs/expansion/empower/B1-7-RELEASE-DECISIONS.md:50:| Commission entitlement | 30% of verified, VAT-exclusive collections on qualifying milestones; bespoke rate needs a recorded approval | Founders, accountant (AP-LR-02) |

A simple electronic signature with a tamper-evident record; **not** a qualified electronic signature | Solicitor (AP-LR-01) |
docs/expansion/empower/B1-7-RELEASE-DECISIONS.md:60:Until AP-LR-01 and AP-LR-02 are decided and an agreement is published, `PARTNER_ACTIVATION_ENABLED` stays off and no partner can be invited.
docs/expansion/empower/B1-7-RELEASE-DECISIONS.md:97:Commercial items (C04, R04, R12, KB-COMM) come only after `AP-COM-03` and `AP-LR-02`.
docs/expansion/empower/B1-7-RELEASE-DECISIONS.md:131:| Agreement terms | Published agreement | BLOCKED (AP-LR-01, AP-LR-02) | Founders, solicitor | | | |

docs/launch-ready/D-PARTNER-ONBOARDING.md:44:The system records a click-to-accept with a typed name, an email-possession proof (the single-use invitation), a server timestamp and a content digest. This is a simple electronic signature with a tamper-evident record. It is **not** a qualified electronic signature, and the product says so wherever acceptance happens. Whether this is sufficient for the ScaleSmiths partner agreement is a legal decision: **AP-LR-01** asks a solicitor to confirm it, or to require an external e-signature provider (identity verification and a completion certificate). No legal sufficiency is claimed here.
docs/launch-ready/D-PARTNER-ONBOARDING.md:48:No commission calculation, eligibility, timing, refund, chargeback, tax, territory, exclusivity, termination or governing-law rule was added or changed. The agreement text is founder content, so none of those terms is invented in code. The advertised 30% figure stays as it was on the public site. **AP-LR-02**: founders confirm the authoritative commercial specification before an agreement containing commercial terms is published.

# ScaleSmiths partner programme capability audit (repo D:\tmp\ss-b210, read-only)

All paths below are relative to D:\tmp\ss-b210. Every switch is parsed as `=== "true"`, so it is OFF when unset or set to any other value, unless a different rule is noted.

## 1. Feature switches

**Admin switches**
- `PARTNER_ACADEMY_ENABLED`, `PARTNER_RESOURCE_CENTRE_ENABLED`, `PARTNER_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_ENABLED`: admin/src/lib/server/empower-partner.ts:10-12
- `PARTNER_OBJECTION_HANDLING_ENABLED`: empower-objections.ts:18
- `PARTNER_UNIFIED_WORKSPACE_ENABLED`: empower-guidance.ts:29
- `EMPOWER_FOUNDER_CONTENT_ENABLED`: empower-content.ts:26
- `PARTNER_PROFILE_PUBLICATION_ENABLED`: expansion-profiles.ts:60
- `PARTNER_QUALIFICATION_ENABLED`: expansion-qualification.ts:16
- `PARTNER_PIPELINE_ENABLED`: partner-pipeline.ts:25
- `PARTNER_PERFORMANCE_ENABLED`: partner-performance.ts:15
- `PARTNER_ACTIVATION_ENABLED`: partner-invitations.ts:15. Written as `!== "true"` → throw, so it is closed when unset.
- `PARTNER_EMAIL_ENABLED`: partner-notifications.ts:20, admin/src/lib/partner-email.ts, and web/src/lib/server/partner-application-email.ts:25.
- `PARTNER_EMAIL_REPLY_TO`: optional string.
- `PARTNER_RETENTION_EXECUTION_ENABLED`: expansion-retention.ts:18. It also needs `PARTNER_APPLICATION_RETENTION_DAYS` to be an integer from 1 to 730; otherwise it fails with 409.
- `ASCEND_ENGINE_ENABLED`, `ASCEND_SCHEDULER_ENABLED`, `ASCEND_AGENT_API_ENABLED`: ascend-engine.ts:34-36
- `ASCEND_MAX_GLOBAL_CONCURRENCY`: Number, default 4 (ascend-engine.ts:38).
- `ASCEND_AUTOMATION_ENABLED`: ascend-automation.ts:9
- Related ones without the prefix: `DELIVERY_HANDOFF_ENABLED` (delivery-handoff.ts:16), `FOUNDER_SALES_COMMAND_ENABLED` (sales-command.ts:24), `REVENUE_INTELLIGENCE_ENABLED` (revenue-intelligence.ts:22).

**Web switches**
- `PARTNER_APPLICATIONS_ENABLED` (web/src/lib/partner-applications.ts:13-23). It is enabled only if all three hold:
  - it equals `"true"`;
  - `PARTNER_APPLICATION_PRIVACY_VERSION` matches `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,80}$`;
  - `PARTNER_APPLICATION_RETENTION_DAYS` is an integer from 1 to 730.
  - There is no default retention period; unset means applications are closed.
- `PUBLIC_PARTNER_PROFILES_ENABLED` (web/src/lib/partner-profile-public.ts:13).

**Canonical config**
- .env.example lines 249-323 list all of the above as `false` (`ASCEND_MAX_GLOBAL_CONCURRENCY=4`; privacy version and retention days are blank).
- There is no admin/.env.example partner section.
- docker-compose*.yml only use `env_file: .env`. docker-compose.release.yml uses `${SS_ENV_FILE:-.env}`.
- ops/ has the ASCEND worker variables only.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:377-401 sets the Empower/Ascend/Activation switches to `"true"`, but only on the disposable browser-test server.

**Drift check**
- Script: scripts/check-release-env-drift.mjs. Run it with `node scripts/check-release-env-drift.mjs <canonical .env> <release .env>` or `npm run check:release-env-drift -- …` from the repo root.
- Its tests are `npm run test:release-env-drift` (also part of `test:ascend-ops`).
- It governs only these switches: `PARTNER_APPLICATIONS_ENABLED`, `PARTNER_APPLICATION_PRIVACY_VERSION`, `PARTNER_APPLICATION_RETENTION_DAYS`, `PARTNER_RETENTION_EXECUTION_ENABLED`, `EMPOWER_FOUNDER_CONTENT_ENABLED`, the four `ASCEND_*` switches, and the `MEGATON_*` switches.
- The Academy, Resource, Knowledge, Objection, Activation, Email and Profile switches are **not** governed by it.

**Recorded production values** (docs/expansion/ascend/evidence/b2-9/production-reconciliation.md:44-47)
- `PARTNER_APPLICATIONS_ENABLED=true`
- `REDACTED`
- `PARTNER_APPLICATION_RETENTION_DAYS=180`
- `PARTNER_RETENTION_EXECUTION_ENABLED=false`
- `EMPOWER_FOUNDER_CONTENT_ENABLED=true`
- `ASCEND_ENGINE_ENABLED=true`, `ASCEND_SCHEDULER_ENABLED=false`, `ASCEND_AGENT_API_ENABLED=false`, `ASCEND_AUTOMATION_ENABLED` unset.
- The same doc reports that 8 of these were missing from the canonical `.env` (drift).
- docs/expansion/ascend/B2-9-PRODUCTION-CERTIFICATION.md §4-5 adds: recruitment on, retention off, 0 agreement acceptances, no published agreement verified.
- No committed doc records production values for Academy, Resources, Knowledge, Objections, Activation, Email, Profiles, Pipeline or Performance. docs/expansion/empower/B1-7-PROJECT-AEGIS-FINAL-REPORT.md:355 says they were "off" at B1.7.

## 2. Academy
- **Status:** implemented, behind `PARTNER_ACADEMY_ENABLED`.
- **Service:** admin/src/lib/server/empower-academy.ts. `getAcademy` :79, `getAcademyCourse` :91, `completeAcademyLesson` :130, `recordAcademyView` :143, `attemptAcademyCheck` :157.
- **Pages:** admin/src/app/partner/academy/page.tsx and [course]/page.tsx. **API:** admin/src/app/api/partner/academy/route.ts.
- **Storage:** courses and lessons are `empower_content_items` of kind `course` / `lesson`, with versions in `empower_content_versions`. A course's `fields.modules[].lessons` holds the lesson item IDs.
- **Progress tables:** `empower_academy_completions` (unique per partner + lesson version), `empower_academy_course_state` ("continue where you left off") and `empower_academy_check_attempts` (graded on the server; retries are kept). Migrations 0092 and 0093.
- **Content source:**
  - Markdown in docs/expansion/empower: CURRICULUM.md, LESSONS-FOUNDATIONS.md, LESSONS-PRACTICE.md, KNOWLEDGE-CHECKS.md.
  - Parsed by admin/src/lib/empower-curriculum.ts and imported as **drafts only** by admin/scripts/import-empower-curriculum.mjs. That script needs `EMPOWER_IMPORT_DATABASE_URL`, `--founder-email` and `--confirm-import`, and refuses non-test databases unless `--allow-database` is passed.
  - Totals: **13 courses, 38 modules, 91 lessons, 65 knowledge checks**.
  - Courses: C01 Welcome to ScaleSmiths; C02 Professional Website Development; C03 SEO and Digital Growth; C04 Growth Partnerships; C05 Website Migration; C06 Bespoke Software and Automation; C07 Finding Prospects (BLOCKED); C08 Discovery Meetings; C09 Presenting ScaleSmiths; C10 Objection Handling; C11 Commercial Policies (BLOCKED); C12 Professional Conduct (BLOCKED); C13 Advanced and Enterprise Opportunities.
  - All are marked `DRAFT` in CURRICULUM.md.
- **Workflow:** draft → in_review → approved → published (also changes_requested, superseded, archived).
  - Partners are served only versions that are published and still inside their `review_by` date.
  - A course can be submitted or published only when every linked lesson is already servable (empower-content.ts:81).
- **Tests:**
  - admin/test/integration/empower-academy.integration.test.ts (skipped unless `EXPANSION_TEST_DATABASE_URL` is set)
  - admin/src/lib/server/empower-academy-isolation.test.ts
  - admin/src/lib/empower-content.test.ts, empower-curriculum.test.ts
  - admin/src/components/empower/academy-contrast.test.ts
  - admin/test/e2e/empower-academy.spec.ts

## 3. Resource centre
- **Status:** implemented, behind `PARTNER_RESOURCE_CENTRE_ENABLED`.
- **Service:** admin/src/lib/server/empower-resources.ts. `listResources` :39 (search), `getResource` :105, `downloadResource` :118, `relatedResourcesForLessons` :127.
- **Pages/API:** admin/src/app/partner/resources (list and [slug]) and api/partner/resources.
- **Storage:** content items of kind `resource` (also `template`), same publish workflow.
- **Search:** PostgreSQL full-text search plus founder-managed `empower_search_synonyms` (migration 0094).
- **Download:** plain-text Markdown of the approved version with its approval details. No files are stored.
- **Legacy:** the frozen B0 library is shown read-only and labelled "legacy".
- **Seed:** 13 Markdown drafts in docs/expansion/empower/resources: R01 Company brochure; R02 Partner handbook; R03 Website development guide; R04 Growth partnership guide; R05 Bespoke software guide; R06 SEO and AEO guide; R07 Discovery questionnaire; R08 Objection handling playbook; R09 Meeting preparation checklist; R10 Technical escalation guide; R11 Commercial pricing reference; R12 Commission and payment reference; R13 Follow-up templates. The importer insists on exactly 13.
- **Tests:** admin/test/integration/empower-resources.integration.test.ts.

## 4. Knowledge base and objection handling
- **Knowledge base:** `PARTNER_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_ENABLED`; empower-knowledge.ts `searchKnowledge` :39. Kind `knowledge`; fields are question, answer, client_explanation, limitations, escalation_*, aliases and topic.
  - Seed: docs/expansion/empower/KNOWLEDGE-BASE.md. **32 entries**; the importer asserts 32.
  - Tests: admin/test/integration/empower-knowledge.integration.test.ts.
- **Objections:** `PARTNER_OBJECTION_HANDLING_ENABLED`; empower-objections.ts `searchObjections` :85, `relatedForObjections` :51. Migration 0097; kind `objection`.
  - Seed: parsed from R08. **12 responses**; the importer asserts 12.
  - Tests: admin/src/lib/empower-objections.test.ts, admin/test/integration/empower-objections.integration.test.ts, admin/test/e2e/empower-objections.spec.ts.
- **Unified guidance** (`PARTNER_UNIFIED_WORKSPACE_ENABLED`): empower-guidance.ts `searchGuidance` :95, `opportunityGuidance` :154, `meetingPreparation` :173, `partnerToday` :202.
  - Tests: empower-guidance.integration.test.ts, partner-guidance.test.ts, empower-workspace.spec.ts.

## 5. Founder content studio (`EMPOWER_FOUNDER_CONTENT_ENABLED`)
- **Where:** the "Content" tab of /expansion. `ContentStudio` is at admin/src/components/expansion/ExpansionWorkspace.tsx:545 and only appears when `contentAdmin.enabled`.
- **Commands:** POST /api/expansion (admin/src/app/api/expansion/route.ts) accepts `create_content_item`, `save_content_draft`, `start_content_revision`, `submit_content`, `decide_content`, `publish_content`, `archive_content`, `add_search_synonym`, `set_search_synonym_active`.
- **Service:** admin/src/lib/server/empower-content.ts. Create :99, save :116, revise :132, submit :149, decide :168, publish :195, archive/withdraw :211, `servableContent` :229, `getContentAdmin` :242.
- **Capabilities:**
  - Preview: "Preview as partners will read it" in SafeMarkdown, plus course and knowledge-check preview (ExpansionWorkspace.tsx:518-531).
  - Edit drafts (author only), versioning (one version in progress at a time), and approve / request changes / reject (reference and notes required).
  - Publish, which supersedes the previously published version.
  - Unpublish: archiving a published version is a withdrawal and needs a reason.
  - Full history: versions, approvals and `expansion_audit`.
  - Lint check on submit, with an override reason.
  - Content kinds: resource, lesson, knowledge, objection, template, course, agreement.
- **Approval rule:** another active founder must approve content you wrote (admin/src/lib/empower-content.ts:264 `approvalAuthority`). Self-approval is allowed only when you are the **only** active founder and you record a reason of at least 10 characters. The founder count is share-locked.
- **Tests:** empower-content.integration.test.ts, empower-solo-founder.integration.test.ts, empower-content.test.ts.

## 6. Partner agreement
- **Infrastructure:** implemented.
  - Agreements are content of kind `agreement`: partner-only, 3-month review cadence (empower-content.ts:103).
  - Migration 0095_partner_agreements.sql: `partner_agreement_digest(title, body)` = SHA-256 of `title\n\nbody` (line 16); `partner_agreement_current()`; table `partner_agreement_acceptances`; an activation guard trigger.
  - Core logic: admin/src/lib/server/partner-agreements-core.ts. `currentAgreements` :32, `assertIssuableAgreement` :38, `recordAcceptance` :47 (versionId and sha256 must match the current text), `acceptOnActivation` :63, `agreementForInvitation` :68, `founderAgreementRegister` :102, `reissueAgreement` :111.
  - Partner entry points: partner-agreements.ts. Overview, `acceptReissuedAgreement`, and `acceptedAgreementDocument`, which recomputes the digest and produces a .txt record stating it is "not a qualified electronic signature".
  - Input parsing: admin/src/lib/partner-agreements.ts.
  - Routes: /partner/agreement and api/partner/agreement; api/expansion/agreements/[id].
  - Tests: admin/src/lib/partner-agreements.test.ts, partner-onboarding.integration.test.ts, admin/test/e2e/partner-onboarding.spec.ts.
- **Agreement documents:**
  - No V4.1 or "4.1" agreement file exists anywhere in docs/, admin/ or web/. The only `V4.1` match is a PNG.
  - docs/expansion/empower/AEGIS-AGREEMENT-INTEGRATION-REVIEW.md §1 says the solicitor-reviewed documents were searched for and "None was found".
  - Open decisions: AP-LR-01 (whether click-to-accept is adequate), AP-LR-02 (commercial terms), AP-AGR-JUR (jurisdiction structure). See docs/expansion/empower/B1-7-RELEASE-DECISIONS.md §2 and :60.
  - **No final approved V4.1 is identifiable.**
- **Activation:** behind `PARTNER_ACTIVATION_ENABLED` (admin/src/lib/server/partner-invitations.ts).
  - `issueInvitation` :38 requires: activation on; a founder; a published, current agreement version; the application in `onboarding` with the agreement, legal, independentStatus and operations confirmations all true; an approved operating market (`expansion_markets`, default GB, advisory lock 7102); and no email collision. The token is 32 bytes and expires after 48h; only its hash is stored.
  - `activatePartnerInvitation` :83 re-checks the market and the acceptance of the exact issued version, then sets the password (12 to 72 bytes), activates the account, and sends the welcome email afterwards.
  - The page admin/src/app/partner/activate/page.tsx reads the token from the URL `#token=` fragment. admin/src/app/api/partner/activate/route.ts:14-15 checks the switch, then the login rate limiter, then supports `action: "preview"`.
  - Tests: partner-invitations.test.ts, partner-invitations.database.test.ts (PGlite), api/partner/activate/route.test.ts.

## 7. Recruitment and applications
- **Public page:** web/src/app/partners/page.tsx:46 and :110. The form appears only if the config is enabled; otherwise it shows "Applications are not open yet".
- **API:** web/src/app/api/partner-applications/route.ts `POST`. Steps, in order:
  1. config gate (503);
  2. origin check (`isPartnerApplicationOriginAllowed` :78; 403);
  3. rate limit per IP hash, then per email hash: `partnerApplication`, 3 per hour (web/src/lib/rate-limit-policy.ts:25);
  4. JSON read and `validatePartnerApplication` (partner-applications.ts:50);
  5. privacy version must equal the configured one (409);
  6. honeypot (silently returns OK);
  7. insert into `partner_applications` with `privacy_version` and `retention_until = now() + days`;
  8. send the "application received" email.
- Tests: web/src/app/api/partner-applications/route.test.ts, web/src/lib/partner-applications.test.ts (includes 180 valid and 731 invalid).
- **Retention:** 180 days in production per the doc; there is no code default. Founder preview, purge and hold actions live in admin/src/lib/server/expansion-retention.ts. Eligible records are declined, withdrawn or archived, past `retention_until`, never became a partner and have no hold. Policy doc: docs/expansion/hardening/PRIVACY-AND-RETENTION.md. Tests: expansion-retention.test.ts.
- **Founder review:** `review_application` in admin/src/lib/server/expansion.ts `founderMutation` :241 (transition check :257). The lifecycle is in admin/src/lib/partner-lifecycle.ts:5-30, mirrored in the database by `partner_application_transition_allowed()` (migration 0095).
  - Founders can move an application to approved_in_principle, agreement_pending, onboarding, declined, withdrawn or archived. There is no applicant self-withdraw endpoint.
  - Optional applicant emails for information_requested and declined are sent at :267.
  - Invite: :273, with an optional emailed link `/partner/activate#token=…`. Reissuing an agreement: :287.
  - UI: admin/src/components/expansion/RecruitmentPanel.tsx. Tests: partner-lifecycle.test.ts, expansion.test.ts.
- **Password reset:** there is **no partner self-service reset or forgot-password flow**. Resets are done by an admin through /api/admin-users/[id] (capability `admin_users.credentials.reset`), per docs/operations/partner-programme-incidents.md:17. An expired invitation can be renewed by issuing it again.

## 8. Transactional email
- **Provider:** only **Resend** (the `resend` 6.17.2 package). It needs `RESEND_API_KEY` and `RESEND_FROM` (example `hello@scalesmiths.co.uk`), plus `PARTNER_EMAIL_ENABLED` and the optional `PARTNER_EMAIL_REPLY_TO`.
  - nodemailer is installed only as the `megaton-smtp` alias for Megaton, not for partner email.
  - There is no Postmark, SendGrid or SES.
- **Code:** admin/src/lib/server/partner-notifications.ts (`deliverPartnerEmail`, `notifyPartner` :56, logging to the `partner_notifications` table with a hashed recipient and an idempotency key; migration 0096) and web/src/lib/server/partner-application-email.ts.
- **Templates:** domain/partner-email.ts:6. Kinds: `application_received`, `information_requested`, `application_declined`, `invitation`, `activated`, `agreement_reissued`. **There is no password-reset email.**
- **Tests:** partner-notifications.database.test.ts, admin/src/lib/partner-email.test.ts, web partner-application-email.test.ts.

## 9. Other capabilities
- **Referral identifier:** implemented. `createReferralCode` is at admin/src/lib/server/expansion-programme.ts:103 and produces `SS-[A-Z2-7]{8}` (table `expansion_referral_codes`, migration 0079). Founders attribute and review referrals via `attributeReferral` :251. No switch. Tests: expansion-programme.test.ts, expansion-concurrency integration test, e2e programme.spec.ts.
- **Achievements and recognition:** programmes, milestones and reward review (0079, with no payable ledger) and founding-partner recognition (expansion-recognition.ts, `nominateFoundingPartner` :52, `getPartnerRecognition` :201; migration 0086). No switch. Integration-tested.
- **Personal webpage:** expansion-profiles.ts (`getPartnerProfile` :76, `submitProfile` :123, `publishProfile` :163; migrations 0087 and 0089). Publishing needs `PARTNER_PROFILE_PUBLICATION_ENABLED`; the web page web/src/app/partners/[slug]/page.tsx needs `PUBLIC_PARTNER_PROFILES_ENABLED`. Both are off. Tests: partner-profile-public.test.ts and the integration test.
- **CircleCard, digital business card, dedicated email:** these exist **only as manual toolkit tracking items** (see section 11). Nothing is provisioned. managed-business-email in web/ is a public client service page, not partner provisioning.
- **Researched prospects:** implemented. expansion-research.ts `createCandidate` :122, `allocateCandidate` :295, plus screening, exclusivity, reassign and release (migration 0084). Founder-only. Integration-tested.
- **Demonstration websites:** **none**. generated-sites/ contains only a .gitignore. `industry_demonstrations` is a manual toolkit item.
- **Meetings, technical assistance, escalation:** implemented in expansion-operations.ts (`requestMeeting` :83, `decideMeeting` :129). Meeting types: joint_sales, technical_scoping, bespoke_discovery, commercial_assistance, proposal_review, training, escalation. Transitions are database-enforced (0081, 0083). Escalation guidance also lives in the knowledge and objection fields and in R10. Tests: expansion-operations.test.ts, programme.spec.ts.
- **Commission centre and withdrawals:** admin/src/lib/server/expansion-finance.ts (`getPartnerFinance` :359, `prepareExpansionPayout` :270, `requestWithdrawal` :472, `reviewWithdrawal` :547; migrations 0069-0075). No switch. Tests: expansion-finance.test.ts (lib and server) and the integration test.
- **Pipeline:** partner-pipeline.ts, `PARTNER_PIPELINE_ENABLED`, migration 0098. Tests: partner-pipeline.database.test.ts, partner-pipeline.test.ts, ascend-pipeline.spec.ts.
- **Qualification:** expansion-qualification.ts, `PARTNER_QUALIFICATION_ENABLED`. Tests: .database.test.ts, partner-qualification.test.ts.
- **Delivery handoff:** delivery-handoff.ts (:42, :72, :106), `DELIVERY_HANDOFF_ENABLED`, migration 0102. Tests: delivery-handoff.database.test.ts, ascend-handoffs.spec.ts.
- **Performance:** partner-performance.ts:19, `PARTNER_PERFORMANCE_ENABLED`. Tests: partner-performance.database.test.ts, partner-performance.test.ts, ascend-performance.spec.ts.

## 10. Partner navigation
- **Main workspace:** admin/src/components/expansion/ExpansionWorkspace.tsx:79 (the items array) and :86 (sidebar links).
  - Partner tabs are always shown: Overview, Prospects & scope, Resource library, Commission centre, Achievements, My web page, Referrals, Onboarding, Meetings.
  - Sidebar links shown only when their flag is on: Performance, Delivery handoffs, Partner Academy, Resource Centre, Knowledge Base, Objection handling, Find guidance.
  - The flags are passed in from admin/src/app/partner/page.tsx:11.
  - Founders additionally get Research, Recognition, Web pages, Programme, Partner operations, Recruitment, Delivery capacity, and Content (only when the studio switch is on).
- **Second nav (Academy/Resources pages):** admin/src/components/empower/AcademyShell.tsx:6-25, using the `PartnerNav` flags performance, pipeline, guidance, academy, resources, knowledge and objections. When Resource Centre or Knowledge Base is off it shows a "coming later" chip instead of a link.

## 11. TOOLKIT_CATALOGUE (admin/src/lib/expansion-operations.ts)
- **Items** (every one has `builtIn: false`):
  - email: "Dedicated ScaleSmiths email address"
  - circlecard: "Personalised CircleCard"
  - business_card: "Digital business card"
  - referral_identifier: "Unique referral identifier"
  - brochures: "Professional branded brochures"
  - pricing_documents: "Pricing documentation"
  - commission_documents: "Commission documentation"
  - industry_demonstrations: "Industry-specific website demonstrations"
  - researched_prospects: "Researched prospects"
  - academy: "Partner Academy access"
  - founder_training: "Optional founder-led training"
  - technical_assistance: "Technical assistance"
  - joint_meetings: "Joint sales meetings"
